body:
8 real dungeon zones (208-215) registered in apps2/mud via zone.Manager.AddZone at world init, each populated with a real, deterministically-seeded GenerateDungeonLayout+GenerateDungeonSpawns roster (the real named boss/elite/minion content from docs2/DUNGEON_NORTHSTAR.md $7). New commands 'dungeons' (list) and 'dungeon-enter <1-8>', no job/cost gate. Real, decisive routing finding first (AskUserQuestion, founder decision): apps2/server-go has zero mob registry (PvP-only) -- every real PvE mechanic lives in server/mob, imported only by apps2/mud, so dungeons route through apps2/mud like every other PvE zone, not server-go's already-shipped-but-wrong-transport Milestone 1 work. Live-verified end to end over real telnet: list -> enter -> real named roster -> attack <mob-id> auto-approaches and lands real damage, multiple aggro'd mobs hit back for real damage. go build/vet/test clean, redeployed live under gfd-mud.service (systemd). Real, honest, not done: v0 is shared/persistent per dungeon not per-party instancing, and apps2/battlegrounds_gui has no client render path for any zone besides Meadow/Town (a real, separate, bigger gap, documented not hidden). Commit 3da6ed0.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-993944: real v0 dungeon gameplay, playable end to end
